description: This file defines the class SugarFieldHandler, which manages different sugar field types, including fixing field types, retrieving appropriate SugarField objects, and rendering Smarty templates for fields based on their definitions.

classes.name: SugarFieldHandler
classes.description: Handler class for managing SugarField types, including type fixing, object retrieval, and display rendering.

methods.name: fixupFieldType
methods.description: Adjusts a given field type to a standardized form.

methods.name: getSugarField
methods.description: Retrieves singleton instance of the appropriate SugarField class based on the field type.

methods.name: displaySmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty template code for displaying a field based on its definition and display context.
